for _ in range(4): action(['LEFT'])
print("at left end, N:", nbar())

action(['LEFT','LEFT'])

print("after double-LEFT, b cols:", min(cols),max(cols), "N:", nbar())
# click legend dots
for (r,c) in [(51,15),(54,12),(54,18),(57,15)]:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
print("after legend clicks, N:", nbar(), "board_changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
